page.title: 遠回し疑問は、語順を戻す

analysis.summaryJa: 直接疑問をCould you tell me、Do you know、I wonderなどの外側表現に入れると、疑問の力は外側が担うため、内側のwh節・whether節は主語＋動詞の通常語順に戻る。be動詞、do-support、助動詞を含む場合も同じ原則で考える。
grammarPoints: 間接疑問の内側は主語＋動詞の通常語順
be動詞はwhere the station isのように主語の後ろに置く
一般動詞ではdo/does/didを内側に残さない
will・can・shouldなどの助動詞は内側で主語の後ろに置く
Could you tell me / Do you knowなど外側だけが疑問語順を担う
I wonderの後ろも通常語順
visualEvidence: 鋭い直接疑問を柔らかい外側表現で包む図
Where is ...? と Could you tell me where ... is? の語順対比
『疑問の気持ちはDo you knowにある』というミニ問題
commonTraps: where is the stationの倒置を内側に残す
助動詞を主語より前に出す
I wonderの後ろを疑問文語順にする
外側が疑問文でないのに疑問符や倒置に引っぱられる

questions.prompt: Could you tell me where the customer service desk -------?

choices.A: is
choices.B: does
choices.C: be
choices.D: is it

questions.translationJa: カスタマーサービス窓口がどこにあるか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問の内側は通常語順なのでwhere the desk isとなります。

questions.prompt: Do you know when the airport shuttle ------- from this hotel?

choices.A: does leave
choices.B: leaves
choices.C: leave does
choices.D: leaving

questions.translationJa: このホテルから空港シャトルがいつ出発するか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: Do you knowが疑問を担うため、内側はwhen the shuttle leavesの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: I wonder why the invoice ------- twice this month.

choices.A: did issue
choices.B: was it issued
choices.C: was issued
choices.D: issuing

questions.translationJa: 今月その請求書がなぜ2回発行されたのか気になります。
questions.explanationJa: wonderの後ろは間接疑問で、why + 主語 + 動詞の語順になります。

questions.prompt: Could you explain how long the inspection -------?

choices.A: will it take
choices.B: does take it
choices.C: taking
choices.D: will take

questions.translationJa: その検査にどれくらい時間がかかるか説明していただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 内側の疑問では倒置せず、the inspection will takeとします。

questions.prompt: Please let me know what time the reception desk ------- tomorrow.

choices.A: opens
choices.B: does open
choices.C: open does
choices.D: is open it

questions.translationJa: 明日受付が何時に開くか知らせてください。
questions.explanationJa: what time以下は内容節なので主語reception deskの後に動詞opensを置きます。

questions.prompt: Can you tell us why the conference room ------- unavailable this afternoon?

choices.A: is it
choices.B: is
choices.C: does
choices.D: be

questions.translationJa: 今日の午後、会議室がなぜ利用できないのか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側のCan you tell usが疑問形なので、内側はwhy the room isの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Do you remember where Ms. Chen ------- the spare key?

choices.A: did put
choices.B: put did
choices.C: put
choices.D: was put

questions.translationJa: チェンさんが予備鍵をどこに置いたか覚えていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 内側は疑問文語順にせず、where Ms. Chen putとします。

questions.prompt: The coordinator asked what time the delivery truck ------- the loading area.

choices.A: would it reach
choices.B: did reach
choices.C: reach would
choices.D: would reach

questions.translationJa: 担当者は配送トラックが何時に荷下ろし場へ着くか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: askedの後ろの間接疑問では主語truckの後にwould reachを置きます。

questions.prompt: Could you tell me which platform the express train ------- from?

choices.A: departs
choices.B: does depart
choices.C: does it depart
choices.D: departing

questions.translationJa: 急行列車がどのホームから出発するか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: which platformの後でも内側はthe train departsという通常語順です。

questions.prompt: We need to find out how much the annual maintenance plan -------.

choices.A: does cost
choices.B: costs
choices.C: cost does
choices.D: is cost

questions.translationJa: 年間保守プランがいくらかかるのか確認する必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: find outの目的語となる間接疑問ではhow much + 主語 + 動詞の語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct indirect question.

choices.A: Could you tell me where is the nearest ATM?
choices.B: Could you tell me where does the nearest ATM be?
choices.C: Could you tell me where the nearest ATM is?
choices.D: Could you tell me where the nearest ATM does?

questions.translationJa: 最寄りのATMがどこにあるか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 内側はwhere the nearest ATM isという通常語順になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “Do you know.”

choices.A: Do you know when does the final train leave?
choices.B: Do you know when leaves the final train?
choices.C: Do you know when the final train does leave? as the neutral form
choices.D: Do you know when the final train leaves?

questions.translationJa: 最終列車がいつ出るか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問の倒置は外側Do you knowにあり、内側はthe train leavesです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “I wonder.”

choices.A: I wonder why the printer stopped working.
choices.B: I wonder why did the printer stop working.
choices.C: I wonder why stopped the printer working.
choices.D: I wonder why does the printer stop working yesterday.

questions.translationJa: プリンターがなぜ動かなくなったのか気になります。
questions.explanationJa: wonderの後ろはwh + 主語 + 動詞の通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct polite question.

choices.A: Could you tell me how long will the repair take?
choices.B: Could you tell me how long the repair will take?
choices.C: Could you tell me how long does the repair take will?
choices.D: Could you tell me how long the repair take will?

questions.translationJa: 修理にどれくらい時間がかかるか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側だけを疑問形にし、内側はthe repair will takeとします。
questions.focus: 助動詞を含む間接疑問

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a meeting location.

choices.A: Please tell me where will the meeting be held.
choices.B: Please tell me where will be held the meeting.
choices.C: Please tell me where the meeting will be held.
choices.D: Please tell me where does the meeting be held.

questions.translationJa: 会議がどこで開かれるか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 受動態でも内側はthe meeting will be heldの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking for a reason.

choices.A: Can you explain why was the order canceled?
choices.B: Can you explain why did the order cancel?
choices.C: Can you explain why the order canceled was?
choices.D: Can you explain why the order was canceled?

questions.translationJa: 注文がなぜ取り消されたのか説明してもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: why以下では主語the orderの後にwas canceledを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with an embedded question after “find out.”

choices.A: We need to find out when the technician can visit.
choices.B: We need to find out when can the technician visit.
choices.C: We need to find out when does the technician can visit.
choices.D: We need to find out when the technician visit can.

questions.translationJa: 技術者がいつ訪問できるか確認する必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: canを含む場合も内側ではthe technician can visitの語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a price.

choices.A: Do you know how much does the upgrade cost?
choices.B: Do you know how much the upgrade costs?
choices.C: Do you know how much costs the upgrade?
choices.D: Do you know how much the upgrade does cost? as the ordinary neutral form

questions.translationJa: アップグレードにいくらかかるか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: how much以下は主語the upgradeの後にcostsを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence for a formal inquiry.

choices.A: Could you tell me whether is the branch office open on Saturday?
choices.B: Could you tell me whether does the branch office open on Saturday?
choices.C: Could you tell me whether the branch office is open on Saturday?
choices.D: Could you tell me whether the branch office open is on Saturday?

questions.translationJa: 支店が土曜日に開いているか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: whetherで始まる間接疑問でも内側は通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence containing two layers of questioning.

choices.A: Do you know why does the system say the password is invalid?
choices.B: Do you know why the system does say is the password invalid?
choices.C: Do you know why says the system the password is invalid?
choices.D: Do you know why the system says the password is invalid?

questions.translationJa: システムがなぜパスワードを無効と表示するか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側だけが疑問形で、why以下はthe system saysという通常語順を保ちます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Where is the baggage counter?” asked politely.

choices.A: Could you tell me where is the baggage counter?
choices.B: Could you tell me where the baggage counter is?
choices.C: Tell me where does the baggage counter be?
choices.D: Could you tell me whether the baggage counter is?

questions.translationJa: 手荷物カウンターがどこにあるか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 直接疑問を丁寧な外側表現に入れると、内側は通常語順になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “When does the seminar begin?” asked through “Do you know.”

choices.A: Do you know when does the seminar begin?
choices.B: Do you know when begins the seminar?
choices.C: Do you know when the seminar begins?
choices.D: Do you know whether the seminar begins?

questions.translationJa: セミナーがいつ始まるか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: when以下を通常語順に戻した文が正しい間接疑問です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Why was the flight delayed?” expressed as a thought.

choices.A: I wonder why was the flight delayed.
choices.B: I wonder whether the flight was delayed.
choices.C: I wonder why did the flight delay.
choices.D: I wonder why the flight was delayed.

questions.translationJa: その便がなぜ遅れたのか気になります。
questions.explanationJa: wonderの後ろではwhy the flight was delayedと通常語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “How long will the orientation last?” asked politely.

choices.A: Could you tell me how long the orientation will last?
choices.B: Could you tell me how long will the orientation last?
choices.C: Could you tell me whether the orientation will last?
choices.D: Could you tell me how long does the orientation last will?

questions.translationJa: オリエンテーションがどれくらい続くか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞willは内側で主語の後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “What time does the store close?” in an indirect question.

choices.A: Please let me know what time does the store close.
choices.B: Please let me know what time the store closes.
choices.C: Please let me know whether the store closes.
choices.D: Please let me know what time closes the store.

questions.translationJa: 店が何時に閉まるか知らせてください。
questions.explanationJa: do-supportを使わず、内側はthe store closesとなります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Is the meeting room available?” asked indirectly.

choices.A: Could you tell me whether is the meeting room available?
choices.B: Could you tell me that the meeting room is available?
choices.C: Could you tell me whether the meeting room is available?
choices.D: Could you tell me where the meeting room is available?

questions.translationJa: 会議室が利用可能かどうか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no疑問を埋め込むとwhether + 主語 + 動詞の形になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Where did the courier leave the package?” as reported information.

choices.A: We need to know where did the courier leave the package.
choices.B: We need to know where the courier did leave the package?
choices.C: We need to know whether the courier left the package.
choices.D: We need to know where the courier left the package.

questions.translationJa: 配達員が荷物をどこに置いたか知る必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の一般動詞でもdidを使わず、courier leftの語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Which entrance should visitors use?” asked politely.

choices.A: Could you tell me which entrance visitors should use?
choices.B: Could you tell me which entrance should visitors use?
choices.C: Could you tell me whether visitors should use an entrance?
choices.D: Could you tell me which entrance do visitors should use?

questions.translationJa: 来訪者がどの入口を使うべきか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: shouldは間接疑問内で主語visitorsの後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “How many rooms does the hotel have?” in an embedded question.

choices.A: Do you know how many rooms does the hotel have?
choices.B: Do you know how many rooms the hotel has?
choices.C: Do you know how many rooms has the hotel?
choices.D: Do you know whether the hotel has rooms?

questions.translationJa: そのホテルに客室が何室あるか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: how many roomsの後ろもthe hotel hasという通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Why did the payment fail?” asked within another question.

choices.A: Can you tell me why did the payment fail?
choices.B: Can you tell me whether the payment failed?
choices.C: Can you tell me why the payment failed?
choices.D: Can you tell me why the payment did fail? as the neutral pattern

questions.translationJa: 支払いがなぜ失敗したのか教えてもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側Can you tell meが疑問を担うため、内側はthe payment failedです。
questions.focus: 外側だけを疑問形にする

questions.prompt: A guest cannot find the fitness center. The receptionist says, “I can help.” She asks, “Could you tell me what floor your room is on first?” Then she explains where the fitness center -------.

choices.A: is it
choices.B: does
choices.C: be
choices.D: is

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客がフィットネスセンターを見つけられません。受付係は案内し、その場所を説明します。
questions.explanationJa: where以下は内容節なのでthe fitness center isの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: The travel agent is comparing two flights. Before booking, she asks the airline, “Do you know when the later flight -------?”

choices.A: departs
choices.B: does depart
choices.C: depart does
choices.D: is depart

questions.translationJa: 旅行代理店は2便を比較しています。予約前に遅い便がいつ出発するか尋ねます。
questions.explanationJa: Do you knowの内側ではwhen the flight departsとします。

questions.prompt: A machine stopped during the night shift. The supervisor wants the cause, so he asks the technician to explain why the machine -------.

choices.A: did stop
choices.B: stopped
choices.C: stopped did
choices.D: does stop

questions.translationJa: 夜勤中に機械が停止しました。上司は原因を知るため、なぜ止まったか説明を求めます。
questions.explanationJa: why節内は通常語順で、過去形stoppedをそのまま使います。

questions.prompt: The hotel is arranging airport transportation for a large group. Could you confirm how many passengers the shuttle -------?

choices.A: can it carry
choices.B: does carry can
choices.C: can carry
choices.D: carry can

questions.translationJa: ホテルは大人数の空港送迎を手配しています。シャトルが何人乗せられるか確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: canは内側で主語shuttleの後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: The client says the online form will not accept her address. Support staff need to determine why the form ------- the entry.

choices.A: does reject
choices.B: reject does
choices.C: is reject
choices.D: rejects

questions.translationJa: 顧客はオンラインフォームが住所を受け付けないと言っています。担当者はなぜ入力を拒否するか調べる必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: determineの後ろは間接疑問なのでform rejectsの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: A visitor calls before arriving at the office. She asks whether the parking garage ------- open after 8:00 p.m.

choices.A: will remain
choices.B: will it remain
choices.C: does remain will
choices.D: remain will

questions.translationJa: 来訪者は到着前に電話し、駐車場が午後8時以降も開いているか尋ねます。
questions.explanationJa: whether節内では主語garageの後ろにwill remainを置きます。

questions.prompt: The conference organizer changed the registration process. Please find out what documents attendees ------- at check-in.

choices.A: do need they
choices.B: need
choices.C: need do
choices.D: does need

questions.translationJa: 会議主催者が登録手続きを変更しました。受付時に参加者が何の書類を必要とするか確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: what documentsが目的語で、内側の語順はattendees needです。

questions.prompt: A supplier quoted a lower price than expected. The purchasing team is asking how long the quoted price ------- valid.

choices.A: will it remain
choices.B: does remain
choices.C: will remain
choices.D: remaining

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は予想より低い価格を提示しました。購買チームはその価格がいつまで有効か確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: how long節内はthe price will remainという通常語順です。

questions.prompt: The front desk received several calls about a canceled tour. Before replying, staff are checking why the operator ------- the cancellation so late.

choices.A: did announce
choices.B: announced did
choices.C: does announce yesterday
choices.D: announced

questions.translationJa: フロントには中止ツアーについて問い合わせが来ています。担当者はなぜ通知が遅かったか確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の間接疑問ではdidを入れずannouncedを使います。

questions.prompt: The new expense system has several approval levels. Employees have asked whom they should contact when a claim is rejected. Human Resources will clarify whom employees ------- first.

choices.A: should contact
choices.B: should they contact
choices.C: do contact should
choices.D: contact should

questions.translationJa: 新しい経費システムには複数の承認段階があります。人事は却下時に誰へ最初に連絡すべきか明確にします。
questions.explanationJa: whomを含む間接疑問でも主語employeesの後ろにshould contactを置きます。
